regions.explanation: At 26.20s, the onset of “solemn” is repeated 2 time(s) before the word is completed (fragment-to-onset spectral similarity 1.00). Repeated onsets before the word is completed fragment it and interrupt the speech rhythm. Fix: Begin the word once, deliberately; a short breath before it helps.

regions.text: man come not from the generosity of
regions.explanation: From 63.72s to 67.18s (“man come not from the generosity of”), loudness relative to the speaker's own level fell 8.0 dB below the reference, bottoming out 12.4 dB down; that is 1.6× the reference speaker's natural word-to-word variation. The loudness falls away across the phrase, so its final words - often the payoff - drop toward the noise floor of the room. Fix: Support the breath through the end of the phrase; the last words need the same energy as the first.
